policy.weight_rationale: Default weights give equal influence to three distinct observable dimensions (transport proximity, service diversity, complementary POI). No empirical evidence justifies preferring one. Competition is neutral by default. Overrides are explicit caller hypotheses; their exact values and modes are hashed, not validated by data.

Геоанализ: 8 недостающих показателей; перечень - в разделе локаций и JSON.
Финансы: 5 неучтённых факторов; ограничения перечислены в финансовом разделе.
Бюджет сравнивается с модельными стартовыми вложениями, а не с проверенной ценой помещения.
Проверить помещения, аренду, реальный спрос, налоги и фактические условия банка.
Данные в ВТБ не отправляются; кредитное решение не принимается.

limitations: OSM network and POI mapping may be incomplete/outdated; no route is not proof of physical inaccessibility.
Directed OSM-node topology only; geometric intersections without shared nodes never connect.
Origin and POI connectors are straight-line modelling assumptions, not verified entrances or paths across barriers; max_snap_m bounds them.
Only ground-level non-bridge/non-tunnel edges accept connectors. Bridges and tunnels can be traversed through real shared nodes.
Reachable segments are a network visualization, not an exact walkable-area polygon or measured pedestrian traffic.
Costs are metres along WGS84 edges plus connectors; not walking time, wheelchair accessibility, demand or profitability.
Conditional access and foot turn restrictions are conservatively excluded; general vehicle one-way does not imply foot one-way.
POI centers may not be entrances. Counts describe features, not people or businesses.
